recognize_zh: 嬰兒骨髓切片中有一個界線清楚的淋巴聚集，中央為較淡染的生發中心；CD79a、CD20 陽性的 B 細胞為主，BCL6 只標記中央生發中心細胞，CD3 陽性 T 細胞分布在周邊，符合反應性生發中心。
features: Well-circumscribed lymphoid aggregate within cellular marrow, with a paler central zone (germinal center)
Aggregate is non-paratrabecular with a mixed small and larger lymphoid cell population
CD79a and CD20 highlight a B-cell nodule with a surrounding B-cell mantle
BCL6 restricted to the central germinal center cells
CD3-positive T cells at the periphery of the aggregate and scattered in the interstitium
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a cellular marrow containing a well-circumscribed, non-paratrabecular lymphoid aggregate with a paler central zone. Immunohistochemistry shows that the aggregate is composed predominantly of CD79a- and CD20-positive B cells, with BCL6 expression confined to the central germinal center cells and CD3-positive T cells distributed at the periphery. The organized compartmentalization of B and T cells supports a reactive process. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphoid follicle with germinal center formation, in keeping with an immune-mediated condition such as autoimmune neutropenia.

ddx.vs: FL typically forms paratrabecular aggregates with BCL2-positive germinal center cells, whereas reactive germinal centers are BCL2-negative and non-paratrabecular.
MZL aggregates are composed of monotonous CD20-positive marginal zone cells often with intrasinusoidal spread and light chain restriction, without organized BCL6-positive germinal centers.
Blasts and hematogones are TdT- and CD34/CD10-positive immature cells in an interstitial distribution rather than an organized follicle with T-cell rim.
Hodgkin involvement shows scattered large CD30/CD15-positive Reed-Sternberg cells in a fibrotic mixed inflammatory background, not a B-cell follicle.

stain: H&E; IHC: CD79a, CD20, BCL6, CD3
